details.description: GPT Audio mini is OpenAI's smaller, cost-efficient sibling of GPT Audio, accepting and producing both text and audio through the Chat Completions API. Like GPT Audio, it is a non-realtime, request/response model rather than a persistent low-latency session, intended for cost-conscious audio applications. Its knowledge cutoff is October 1, 2023, and OpenAI is retiring it on January 20, 2027 in favor of gpt-audio-1.5.
advantages: Lower-cost, smaller-footprint version of GPT Audio aimed at cost-conscious multimodal applications (OpenAI API docs).
Supports function calling and prompt caching (OpenAI API docs).
disadvantages: OpenAI is retiring GPT Audio mini on January 20, 2027, with gpt-audio-1.5 as the recommended replacement (OpenAI API deprecations page).
Only works through the Chat Completions endpoint; not compatible with Live sessions, Realtime, Assistants, Batch or fine-tuning (OpenAI API docs).
Knowledge cutoff of October 1, 2023 (OpenAI API docs).
use_cases: Cost-efficient audio-in, audio-out applications built on the Chat Completions API
Voice applications that combine audio conversation with function calling

notes: The target groups two Azure snapshots (gpt-audio-mini, gpt-audio-mini-2025-10-06) with an OpenAI-hosted later snapshot (gpt-audio-mini-2025-12-15, the current default per OpenAI's docs). OpenAI's deprecations page confirms a January 20, 2027 shutdown for the base gpt-audio-mini alias, matching one of the two dates in the catalog facts; I could not confirm which snapshot the second catalog date (2027-04-06) applies to, so no specific date beyond the confirmed one is stated. No accuracy-style benchmark for this model was found on any maker, host or third-party page.
